eldora.note: 5:24 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Friday, April 3, 2026. Bundle up today! It's a cold one, with a high near 29 and wind chill values as low as -4, so layer up and keep that skin covered. Closing Weekend starts today! From the DOJoe Memorial Race to live music, good food, and all the spring stoke you can handle, we've packed the final days with some of our favorite events. There's still time to sign up for the DOJoe race if you haven't already, and lift tickets are only $49 through Sunday. Click here to see everything we've got planned. See you out there! NWS Weather Snapshot: A 30 percent chance of snow showers, mainly after noon. Partly sunny, with a high near 29. Uphill and Nordic Skiing... The Nordic Center is now closed for the season. Check Nordic Pulse for the latest update. Uphill Access is now closed for the season. Visit eldora.com/uphill for more info. 2026-27 season passes are now on sale . Lock in your lowest price now, before prices increase on April 30. Stay in the loop: This page, eldora.com/conditions , is always your go-to for the latest updates, but you can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224: ELDORA for general alerts, UPHILL for uphill-specific updates, or NORDIC for Nordic updates. Message and data rates may apply. Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill! -- GENERAL INFORMATION Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, seven days a week. Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, seven days a week. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here . EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers. Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com

killington.note: Good morning, Beast family, We had an interesting one on the slopes yesterday, but we still made it happen and laid down carves. Friday could be off to an interesting start, but the good vibes and warming temps will prevail. Flurries and light icing came through last night, but things are already clearing up. Today brings a little bit of everything, scattered showers early with a chance of a rumble of thunder mid-morning before skies start to break for some afternoon sun. Expect temps climbing near the mid-50s with strong southwest winds across the peaks. Surface conditions may be variable with areas ranging from loose granular to machine-groomed hard pack. As the day progresses and temps warm up, surfaces should improve to hold more soft, wet granular snow. Our grooming team went after the usual spring plan last night and moved snow to places that needed it. While our snow cover remains strong, the operators are strategizing how to best cover surfaces and keep things skiing & riding late into the season. They’ll be preparing Outer Limits for the Bear Mountain Mogul Challenge this Saturday. Bear Claw, Cruise Control, and Bunny Buster, among a long list of other trails are resurfaced for your carving pleasure. Be sure to check out the Lifts & Trails Report for the full list of groomers and open terrain. Please note that areas of thin cover are continuing to appear as we move through this spring-like weather pattern. Ski Patrol is actively monitoring conditions, marking hazards and noting where walking may be required. The best beginner terrain is available over on Snowshed Slope. As we continue into spring, our grooming team will keep pushing snow around and patching up those thinner spots where coverage allows. Looking ahead, we’re getting ready for one of our signature spring events on Saturday, the Bear Mountain Mogul Challenge . It’s always a great time at Bear with big bumps, big energy, and plenty of action. Even if you're not competing or volunteering, come be a part of the scene and catch all the action from the sidelines. With live music from Nick Bredice and Rhys Chalmers followed up by Jamie's Junk Show, the après vibes are sure to be immaculate. Shuttles will run from 6:00 a.m. until 6:00 p.m. to transport guests between base areas. You may see people on the Bear Quad before and after the lift closes, but that access is only for race crew, and it will be open to the public as usual from 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Also, the Skyepeak quad will load 4:30 p.m. to 4:45 p.m. and the Northbrook Quad will run from 4:45 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. to help get you back to where you came. We are scheduled to have 16 lifts spinning with key lifts open at 9:00 a.m. and the North Ridge Quad scheduled at 9:30 a.m., with the Canyon and South Ridge Quads spinning at 10:00 a.m. Please note: Although we will be running a bonus weekend over at Skyeship this weekend, Stage I will be closed until Friday. On the kparks front, our Bear parks, Dream Maker and The Stash, are firing with a full lineup of features. Over on Ramshead, Timberline continues to shine with 44 features, 5 jumps, and a halfpipe. Our Parks Crew recently refreshed features in Timberline and gave the halfpipe a fresh cut. Easy Street and Lil’ Stash are also dialed in for fun progression options. Check the Terrain Parks Report for all the details. For a music scene this weekend, DJ Action Jackson will be playing tracks on the K-1 patio this Saturday from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. Come get your moves on. Have a fun Friday! - Evan Operating Day: 142 Season passes for 26/27 are now on sale! Lock in the lowest price on Beast 365 or Winter Unlimited passes with lots of perks, plus free skiing & riding for the rest of this spring. And there's more good news for families: Youth & Child pass pricing has been significantly reduced for next season, with over $300 in savings available on Beast 365 access. Lifts Key lifts operate seven days a week from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on Monday through Friday, and from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday. The North Ridge Quad will open at 9:30 a.m. on weekdays and 8:00 a.m. on weekends, the Canyon Quad will spin from 10:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Monday, Wednesday, Friday and 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on weekends, and the Sunrise Village Triple will spin until 3:00 p.m. on weekdays and 4:00 p.m. on weekends. Upcoming lift closure dates: Snowshed Express Quad - Sunday, April 5th Skyeship Express Gondola Stage I - Sunday, April 5th Sunrise Village Triple - Sunday, April 5th A note for our snowboarders: Thanks to our new cabins on the Skyeship Gondola, we're asking you to please utilize the snowboard racks outside of each cabin. If the racks are entirely full, please put your boards underneath the seats. This differs from our K-1 Gondola, where all snowboards should be brought inside the cabins. Just remember: outside Skyeship, inside K-1! The Tubing Park presented by bubly is closed for the season. copper mountain.note: Happy Friday! The snow keeps falling and the stoke keeps rising. 4 inches of new snow overnight with more flurries continuing throughout the day. Temps are dropping and could reach single digits in the morning so be sure to layer up. The high will be in the teens with winds from the west around 15-20 mph, gusting into the 40s. Go out and enjoy some soft turns, but remember that this new snow may have covered up previously visible hazards so ski and ride safely.

snowbird.note: Howdy and good morning! This is Kolton with your Snow Report for Friday, April 3. The new snow continued overnight and we’ve picked up an additional 4” bringing our April storm total up to 28”. That means there will be plenty of soft powder stashes waiting for you! Today’s forecast includes light snow in the morning with sunny conditions returning around noon. Winds will be light today from the Northwest so I really can’t imagine a better day to be up at The Bird! This weekend will be stacked with amazing Easter events, so make sure to spend the whole weekend up here. From free burritos at Passholder Appreciation Breakfast to Easter Brunch at The Aerie and Easter egg hunts on Chickadee (ohh ya, and Plazapalooza will be jammin’), I hope to see you up here. A quick reminder, Chickadee Lift will close for the 2025-26 season for replacement this Monday, April 6. The new Chickadee Lift is expected to reopen for summer operations in July. ALL uphill travel is closed. Thanks for skiing & riding with us! #GMTB
